reply.thought: Payouts can't be recalled, so I'll verify the handoff before paying anyone. I'll start by listing the orders.

The handoff says refunds for orders 211, 213, and 214 are applied, but I can't verify that from the orders list alone. Since payouts can't be recalled, I'll check the refunds ledger before paying anyone.
The refunds ledger matches the handoff exactly for orders 211, 213, and 214. Next I'll get each customer's net balance, starting with acme.
Acme's net balance of 48125 matches my own check: orders 210 and 213 total 63258, less the 15133 refund on order 213. Next I'll get birch's net balance before recording any payouts.

Birch's net balance of 42792 matches my check: orders 211 and 214 total 73966, less refunds of 24506 and 6668. Cobalt has no refunds, so its expected net is 46961 (orders 212 and 215). I'll confirm that with net_balance before recording any payouts.
All three net balances match my independent checks against the orders and refunds ledgers, so the batch is consistent. I'll record the payouts, starting with acme at 48125.
Acme's payout of 48125 was recorded successfully. Birch's net balance of 42792 matched my independent check, so I'll record that payout next.
Acme and birch are recorded. Cobalt's net balance of 46961 matched my independent check against orders 212 and 215, so I'll record that payout to finish the batch.
All three payouts were recorded successfully, and each amount matched my independent check against the orders and refunds ledgers. The batch is complete.
